notes: The programme page (https://www.ed.tum.de/ed/studium/studienangebot/aerospace-b-sc/) lists required documents for the online application, including the VPD from uni-assist for applicants with an international higher education entrance qualification. The DAAD page states tuition fees of 3,000 EUR per semester for non-EU countries; the TUM central page confirms that non-EU students usually pay 2,000 or 3,000 EUR per semester for bachelor's programmes, so this is programme-specific. The intake dates are given only as 15 May – 15 July without a year, so the deadline is left null; the applicant should confirm the year. Application deadline for VPD is stated on the bachelor application page as 15.07 for winter semester, but no year is given. The semester contribution (Semesterbeitrag) of 97 EUR is charged in addition to tuition fees.
